decisions.reason: The contract says, "If the signal transmission fails, it proceeds to the operational state." The exact binding identifies BrakingState as the source, OperationalState as the target, and the same owner scope. The supplied inventory and completed S2 receipt show no BrakingState-to-OperationalState transition; the existing BrakingState-to-InitialState transition has different endpoints. decisions.basis: Dossier 0001:r3:i1 supplies the same exact endpoint contract with additional source and model transition references, plus a complete closed transition inventory and completed S2 receipt.
decisions.reason: The quoted contract requires that, on signal transmission failure, BrakingState transitions to OperationalState. The supplied inventory instead contains InitialState-to-OperationalState on Signal_Transmission_Fails and BrakingState-to-InitialState on Signal_Feedback_Sent, with no BrakingState-to-OperationalState edge. Reading the requirement as referring to the InitialState path conflicts with the explicit source phrase identifying the braking state and with the separately listed initial-state transition.
